about_us.title: Our Story
about_us.content:
Welcome to Pawché, where the canine lifestyle meets high-fashion. We believe that true luxury isn't just for you—it’s for your most loyal companion too. Inspired by the sophistication of the world's most iconic fashion houses, Pawché was born from a simple realization: your dog lives for luxury too.

Our curated collection features only the most exquisite pieces, from designer couture and gold-toned jewelry to velvet loungers and marble feeding stations. We don't just sell pet products; we provide a lifestyle upgrade for the dog that deserves everything.

Every item in The Vault, The Wardrobe, and beyond is selected for its superior craftsmanship and timeless aesthetic. With a palette of deep obsidian and radiant gold, Pawché is more than a brand—it's a statement.

Welcome to the club. Your dog has been waiting.

the_wardrobe.title: The Wardrobe
the_wardrobe.description: Editorial-ready couture for the discerning canine. From streetwear-inspired sets to formal gala-ready gowns, The Wardrobe ensures your dog is the best-dressed in any room. Discover fashion that bridges the gap between the runway and the park.

the_penthouse_suite.title: The Penthouse Suite
the_penthouse_suite.description: Elevate your home with canine furniture that doubles as art. The Penthouse Suite features velvet loungers, designer crates, and statement pieces designed to blend seamlessly with the most sophisticated interiors. Luxury living starts at floor level.

the_getaway.title: The Getaway
the_getaway.description: Travel in unparalleled style. Whether it’s a cross-continental flight or a weekend escape, our high-end carriers and travel sets ensure your pet arrives refreshed and refined. The world is their runway—take them there in comfort.

the_vault.title: The Vault
the_vault.description: The pinnacle of canine opulence. The Vault houses our most exclusive accessories, featuring crystal-encrusted collars, gold-toned statement pieces, and rare jewelry. These are not mere accessories; they are investments in elegance.

the_sleep_suite.title: The Sleep Suite
the_sleep_suite.description: Indulge in the art of the nap. The Sleep Suite offers silk-lined bedding, orthopedic luxury mattresses, and plush sleep masks designed for the dog who takes their beauty rest seriously. Sweet dreams, reimagined.

the_spa.title: The Spa
the_spa.description: Rituals of relaxation for the pampered pet. Our Spa collection features premium grooming kits, aromatherapy-infused shampoos, and plush robes. Transform routine maintenance into a five-star sensory experience.

the_accessory_bar.title: The Accessory Bar
the_accessory_bar.description: The finishing touches that make the look. From designer leashes and harnesses to silk bandanas and canine sunglasses, The Accessory Bar provides the essential details for a life lived beautifully.

bowls_kitchen.title: Bowls & Kitchen
bowls_kitchen.description: Fine dining for the four-legged epicurean. Explore feeding stations crafted from marble, gold-finished bowls, and crystal water fountains. Because every meal should be a celebrated event.
